The film is being described as the "Third" live-action adaptation of the Street Fighter video game franchise, when in truth, it is the "Fourth" live-action adaptation. The actual 3rd live-action feature-length adaptation of Street Fighter was a film originally released in 2014 as a web-series called "Street Fighter: Assassin's Fist", made in collaboration with CAPCOM.
